config.expected_if_false: In both seeds, N=128 trained force R2 is >= 0.06 below the same seed's N=64 m2-fixed value, similar to the wide-m2 drop. That would put the loss in reading out 1/r^2, not in m2. A drop between 0.03 and 0.06, or seeds that disagree, is inconclusive.
config.expected_if_true: In both seeds, |N=128 trained force R2 - same-seed N=64 m2-fixed trained force R2| <= 0.03 and the force control changes by <= 0.03. Headroom-normalised accel_step is in [0.55, 0.85].
config.hypothesis: The N=64 to N=128 drop in trained force R2 (0.08-0.13 per seed with m2 in [0.1, 1]) comes from losing the m2 factor of force, not from the 1/r^2 part. Layer-1 distance R2 does not fall with N. So with m2 fixed at 0.5 (force = 0.5/r^2), N=128 trained force R2 for seeds 20-21 (data_seed 0, otherwise identical to the paired N=64 m2-fixed arm) stays within 0.03 of the same seed's N=64 m2-fixed value. Trained R2 and control R2 are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and paired per seed. If the paired arm is unavailable, the comparison is reported as not computed.
